changeSet.sql: IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.LoadItem', 'AssetUid') IS NULL BEGIN alter table LoadItem add AssetUid uniqueidentifier null; END IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.LoadItem', 'ParentAssetUid') IS NULL BEGIN alter table LoadItem add ParentAssetUid uniqueidentifier null; END
